body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at Louvre Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat - جزيرة السعديات - Cultural District - أبو ظبي - United Arab Emirates. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Louvre Abu Dhabi. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Alexandra as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour is designed for anyone interested in architecture, culture, and innovation. It takes you on a journey through the Saadiyat Cultural District, showcasing Abu Dhabi's rich heritage and modern developments. Your ticket to the Louvre Abu Dhabi is included.
>
> (!) Please note that this tour does not include an audio guide inside the Louvre Abu Dhabi.
>
> The tour begins at the stunning Louvre Abu Dhabi, where you can marvel at the vast dome and intricate metal latticework. From there, you will walk through the Saadiyat Cultural District, visiting notable sites such as the Zayed National Museum, the Abrahamic Family House, the Berklee College of Music, and Manarat Al Saadiyat. Each stop offers a unique perspective on Abu Dhabi's commitment to art, heritage, and sustainability.
>
> As you continue your journey, you will pass by the luxurious Mamsha Al Saadiyat beachfront community and finally arrive at the Guggenheim Museum, with its innovative design by Frank Gehry. Along the way, you will experience the blend of traditional and modern architecture, vibrant community spaces, and the city's dedication to cultural exchange and environmental conservation. This tour promises memorable experiences, from the 'rain of light' effect at the Louvre to the futuristic design of the Guggenheim Museum.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €22.98. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 176 ratings and 55 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
